v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.la: Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
r.en: And my mouth shall declare thy praise.

full.en: The Lord is a great King * Come, let us adore Him.

la: Veníte, exsultémus Dómino, iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.

Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
en: Come let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.
Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.

v.en: I will praise the name of God.

r.en: And I will magnify him with praise.

text.la: In Deo salutáre meum * et glória mea: et spes mea in Deo est.
text.en: In God is my salvation * and my glory: and my hope is in God.

text.la: Vidéte ópera Dómini, * et audítam fácite vocem laudis eius.
text.en: Behold the works of the Lord * and make the voice of his praise to be heard.

text.la: Audíte, omnes * qui timétis Deum, quanta fecit ánimæ meæ.
text.en: Come and hear, all ye that fear God * what great things he hath done for my soul.

text.la: Exsúrgat Deus, * et dissipéntur inimíci eius. ‡
text.en: Let God arise, * and let his enemies be scattered. ‡

text.la: Deus noster, * Deus salvos faciéndi: et Dómini sunt éxitus mortis.
text.en: Our God * is the God of salvation: and the Lord of the issues from death.
In the churches * bless ye God the Lord.

text.la: Salvum me fac, * Deus, quóniam intravérunt aquæ usque ad ánimam meam. ‡
text.en: Save me, O God * for the waters are come in even unto my soul. ‡

text.la: Propter inimícos meos * éripe me, Dómine.
text.en: O Lord, save me * from my enemies.

text.la: Quǽrite Dóminum, * et vivet ánima vestra.
text.en: Look for the Lord * and your soul shall live.

text.la: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
text.en: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

text.la: Exáudi, Dómine Iesu Christe, preces servórum tuórum, et miserére nobis: Qui cum Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivis et regnas in sǽcula sæculórum.
text.en: O Lord Jesus Christ, graciously hear the prayers of Thy servants, and have mercy upon us, Who livest and reignest with the Father, and the Holy Ghost, ever world without end.

benedictio.la: Benedictióne perpétua benedícat nos Pater ætérnus.
benedictio.en: May the Eternal Father bless us with an eternal blessing.

source.en: Lesson from the first book of Kings

text.la: 1 Venit autem Róboam in Sichem; illuc enim congregátus erat omnis Israël ad constituéndum eum regem. 2 At vero Ieróboam fílius Nabat, cum adhuc esset in Ægýpto prófugus a fácie regis Salomónis, audíta morte eius, revérsus est de Ægýpto. 3 Miserúntque et vocavérunt eum. Venit ergo Ieróboam, et omnis multitúdo Israël, et locúti sunt ad Róboam, dicéntes: 4 Pater tuus duríssimum iugum impósuit nobis; tu ítaque nunc immínue páululum de império patris tui duríssimo, et de iugo gravíssimo quod impósuit nobis, et serviémus tibi. 5 Qui ait eis: Ite usque ad tértium diem, et revertímini ad me.
text.en: 1 And Roboam went to Sichem: for thither were all Israel come together to make him king. 2 But Jeroboam the son of Nabat, who was yet in Egypt, a fugitive from the face of king Solomon, hearing of his death, returned out of Egypt. 3 And they sent and called him: and Jeroboam came, and all the multitude of Israel, and they spoke to Roboam, saying: 4 Thy father laid a grievous yoke upon us: now therefore do thou take off a little of the grievous service of thy father, and of his most heavy yoke, which he put upon us, and we will serve thee. 5 And he said to them: Go till the third day, and come to me again.

body.la: Præparáte corda vestra Dómino, et servíte illi soli:
body.en: Prepare your hearts unto the Lord, and serve Him Only

refrain.la: Et liberábit vos de mánibus inimicórum vestrórum.
refrain.en: And He will deliver you out of the hand of your enemies.

verse.la: Convertímini ad eum in toto corde vestro, et auférte deos aliénos de médio vestri.
verse.en: Return unto Him with all your hearts, and put away the strange gods from among you.

benedictio.la: Unigénitus Dei Fílius nos benedícere et adiuváre dignétur.
benedictio.en: May the Son, the Sole-begotten, mercifully bless and keep us.

text.la: 5 Cumque abiísset pópulus, 6 Íniit consílium rex Róboam cum senióribus, qui assistébant coram Salomóne patre eius cum adhuc víveret, et ait: Quod datis mihi consílium ut respóndeam pópulo huic? 7 Qui dixérunt ei: Si hódie obedíeris pópulo huic et servíeris et petitióni eórum césseris locutúsque fúeris ad eos verba lénia, erunt tibi servi cunctis diébus. 8 Qui derelíquit consílium senum, quod déderant ei, at adhíbuit adolescéntes, qui nutríti fúerant cum eo, et assistébant illi.
text.en: 5 And when the people was gone, 6 King Roboam took counsel with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and he said: What counsel do you give me, that I may answer this people? 7 They said to him: If thou wilt yield to this people today, and condescend to them, and grant their petition, and wilt speak gentle words to them, they will be thy servants always. 8 But he left the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men, that had been brought up with him, and stood before him.

body.la: Deus ómnium exaudítor est: ipse misit Angelum suum, et tulit me de óvibus patris mei:
body.en: God, Which heareth all, even He sent His Angel, and took me from keeping my father's sheep, and

refrain.la: Et unxit me unctióne misericórdiæ suæ.
refrain.en: Anointed me with the oil of His mercy.

verse.la: Dóminus, qui erípuit me de ore leónis, et de manu béstiæ liberávit me.
verse.en: The Lord That delivered me out of the mouth of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear

benedictio.la: Spíritus Sancti grátia illúminet sensus et corda nostra.
benedictio.en: May the grace of the Holy Spirit enlighten all our hearts and minds.

text.la: 13 Respondítque rex pópulo dura, derelícto consílio seniórum quod ei déderant, 14 Et locútus est eis secúndum consílium iúvenum dicens: Pater meus aggravávit iugum vestrum, ego autem addam iugo vestro; pater meus cécidit vos flagéllis, ego autem cædam vos scorpiónibus. 15 Et non acquiévit rex pópulo, quóniam aversátus fúerat eum Dóminus, ut suscitáret verbum suum, quod locútus fúerat in manu Ahíæ Silonítæ, ad Ieróboam fílium Nabat. 16 Videns ítaque pópulus quod noluísset eos audíre rex, respóndit ei, dicens: Quæ nobis pars in David? vel quæ heréditas in fílio Isai?
text.en: 13 And the king answered the people roughly, leaving the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, 14 And he spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying: My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke: my father beat you with whips, but I will beat you with scorpions. 15 And the king condescended not to the people: for the Lord was turned away from him, to make good his word, which he had spoken in the hand of Ahias the Silonite, to Jeroboam the son of Nabat. 16 Then the people seeing that the king would not hearken to them, answered him, saying: What portion have we in David? or what inheritance in the son of Isai? Go home to thy dwellings, O Israel, now David look to thy own house. So Israel departed to their dwellings.

body.la: Dóminus, qui erípuit me de ore leónis, et de manu béstiæ liberávit me,
body.en: The Lord That delivered me out of the mouth of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear

refrain.la: Ipse me erípiet de mánibus inimicórum meórum.
refrain.en: He will deliver me out of the hand of mine enemies.

verse.la: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
verse.en: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

text.la: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi Laudes separandæ sint.
text.en: Skip the rest, unless praying Lauds separately.

text.la: Largíre nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine, semper spíritum cogitándi quæ recta sunt, propítius et agéndi: ut, qui sine te esse non póssumus, secúndum te vívere valeámus.
text.en: Grant to us, Lord, we beseech thee, the spirit to think and do always such things as be rightful, that we, who cannot do anything that is good without thee, may by thee be enabled to live according to thy will.
